caption:
The Sun’s air gets hotter as you rise. Magnetism, maybe.

The white blaze is a solar flare: a burst of light and particles.
Magnetic fields twist and snap. That lets the energy out.
This one is M-class. X-class flares are ten times bigger.

What the astronomers say: magnetic fields may heat the Sun’s air, and the same fields can snap and set off a flare.
